title: Medvedev April Fool's interview on Russia's UFO file
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Medvedev April Fool's interview on Russia's UFO file, about an unknown time at Russia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Medvidev was interviewed actually and it was on April Fool's Day and an interviewer asked him about um UFOs and thought that you know he would not take it seriously and then he goes, "Oh yeah, no, we have an extensive file about this stuff.
